accepted.quote: Do not release spray at a height greater than 10 feet above the vegetative canopy, unless a greater application height is necessary for pilot safety.

accepted.summary: required droplet size category

accepted.quote: The boom length must not exceed 65% of the wingspan for airplanes or 75% of the rotor blade diameter for helicopters.

accepted.summary: maximum wind speed for aerial application
accepted.quote: Do not apply when wind speeds exceed 10 miles per hour at the application site.

accepted.quote: Do not apply during temperature inversions.

accepted.summary: maximum nozzle height above ground or crop canopy
accepted.quote: Apply with the nozzle height recommended by the manufacturer, but no more than 3 feet above the ground or crop canopy.

accepted.summary: required droplet size category
accepted.quote: For all applications, applicators are required to use a fine to medium or coarser droplet size (ASABE S572.I).

accepted.summary: maximum wind speed for ground boom application
accepted.quote: Do not apply when wind speeds exceed 10 miles per hour at the application site.

accepted.summary: prohibition on application during temperature inversions
accepted.quote: Do not apply during temperature inversions.

accepted.summary: use highest practical spray volume to produce larger droplets
accepted.quote: Increasing the spray volume so that larger droplets are produced will reduce spray drift. Use the highest practical spray volume for the application.

accepted.quote: Use the lowest spray pressure recommended for the nozzle to produce the target spray volume and droplet size.

accepted.summary: consider using nozzles designed to reduce drift

accepted.quote: Generally, to reduce fine droplets , nozzles should be oriented parallel with the airflow in flight.

accepted.summary: boom should remain level with crop and have minimal bounce
accepted.quote: For ground equipment, the boom should remain level with the crop and have minimal bounce.

accepted.quote: Higher release heights increase the potential for spray drift.

accepted.summary: consider using shielded sprayers
accepted.quote: Consider using shielded sprayers.

accepted.summary: verify shields not interfering with uniform deposition
accepted.quote: Verify that the shields are not interfering with the uniform deposition of the spray on the target area

accepted.summary: use larger droplets in hot and dry conditions
accepted.quote: When making applications in hot and dry conditions, use larger droplets to reduce effects of evaporation.

accepted.summary: avoid applications during temperature inversions

accepted.quote: AVOID APPLICATIONS DURING GUSTY WIND CONDITIONS.

accepted.summary: avoid spray drift to nearby crops
accepted.quote: Avoid spray drift to nearby crops as this product will af fect plant growth, resulting in injury or reduced yields.

accepted.summary: Prohibition on applying through any type of irrigation system
accepted.quote: Do not apply this product through any type of irrigation system.

accepted.summary: Prohibition on preparing more spray solution than required for one day's use
accepted.quote: Do not prepare more spray solution than required for one day's use.

accepted.summary: Prohibition on allowing spray solution to stand overnight
accepted.quote: Do not allow the spray solution to stand overnight.

accepted.summary: Requirement to fill spray tank 1/2 to 3/4 full of water
accepted.quote: Fill the spray tank 1/2 to 3/4 full of water.

accepted.summary: Requirement to agitate water and continue agitation throughout mixing and spraying operations
accepted.quote: Agitate the water and continue agitation throughout mixing and spraying operations.

accepted.summary: Requirement to add product to tank followed by remaining water
accepted.quote: Add [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] to the tank followed by the remaining amount of water.

accepted.summary: Requirement to add any other tank mix partner products
accepted.quote: Add any other tank mix partner products.

accepted.summary: Prohibition on allowing spray solution to sit without agitation longer than 5 to 10 minutes
accepted.quote: Do not allow the spray solution to sit without agitation longer than 5 to 10 minutes.

accepted.summary: Requirement to wash exposed acrylic plastic-type materials with soap and water within 1 hour of exposure
accepted.quote: Therefore, ensure that any exposed acrylic plastic-type materials (e.g., aircraft windshields) are washed thoroughly with soap and water within 1 hour of exposure to the spray droplets.

accepted.summary: Requirement to wash all metal parts of aircraft and other spray equipment with soap and water after application
accepted.quote: When the application is completed, all metal parts of the aircraft and other spray equipment which were exposed to the spray solution should be washed thoroughly with soap and water.

accepted.summary: Prohibition on harvesting cotton until 7 days after application
accepted.quote: Do not harvest cotton until 7 days after an application of this product.

accepted.unit: lb ethephon AI per acre per year

accepted.quote: Do not apply more than 2.0 lb ethephon AI per acre per year.

accepted.summary: Prohibition on applying if rain is expected within 6 hours
accepted.quote: Do not apply this product if rain is expected within 6 hours as product performance may be reduced.

accepted.summary: Prohibition on planting back another crop within 30 days after application
accepted.quote: Do not plant back another crop within 30 days after application.

accepted.quote: If small grains are planted earlier than 1 month after an [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] application or are planted between the cotton plant rows which were treated with this product, these crops can only be used as cover crops. Do not harvest the grain crops for food or feed.

accepted.quote: Select the type of equipment (ground or air) and spray volumes which will ensure thorough coverage of bolls and foliage.

accepted.quote: Apply this product when a sufficient number of unopened bolls have matured to give the desired yield.

accepted.quote: By air: Apply in a minimum spray volume of 2 gal/A (5 gal/A in AZ and CA).

accepted.quote: It is recommended that an application of a defoliant be made BEFORE an [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] application to facilitate boll and foliage coverage by this product.

accepted.summary: Allowed tank-mix partners for Ethephon E-AG 6
accepted.quote: [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] may be applied as a tank mixture or in sequence with the following products: Def ®, Folex®, Dropp®, Dropp® Ultra, Ginstar®, Harvade®, Methyl Parathion, Guthion®, and Malathion®.

accepted.quote: Use caution when this product is applied as a tank mix with defoliants as a slight reduction in boll opening could occur.

accepted.summary: Only tank mix with desiccants if plant desiccation is required
accepted.quote: Only apply this product as a tank mix with desiccants if plant desiccation is required.

accepted.summary: Do not use defoliant unless sufficient mature unopened bolls are present
accepted.quote: Do not use a defoliant unless sufficient mature unopened bolls are present to produce the desired yield.

accepted.summary: Do not tank mix with desiccants if cotton is to be spindle harvested
accepted.quote: DO NOT TANK MIX THIS PRODUCT WITH DESICCANTS IF COTTON IS TO BE SPINDLE HARVESTED.

accepted.quote: DO NOT MIX THIS PRODUCT WITH AMMONIUM THIOSULFATE AS THESE MIXTURES MAY RESULT IN FORMATION OF TOXIC FUMES.

accepted.quote: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, TANK MIXTURES OF [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] WITH DESICCANTS CONTAINING SODIUM CHLORATE COULD RESULT IN THE FORMATION OF HYPOCHLOROUS ACIDS WHICH ON HEATING WILL EMIT TOXIC CHLORIDE FUMES.

accepted.quote: Make application 4 to 7 days before the [Ethephon E- AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] boll -opening application.

accepted.quote: Within 24 to 72 hours after the [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] application, mature, sprayed leaves will begin to turn yellow, but the exact timing is dependent on the weather so that under cooler temperatures, yellowing will be delayed while under warm, sunny conditions, yellowing occurs faster.

accepted.quote: Apply over-the-top spray as a fine mist using three nozzles (one nozzle tip over the center of the plant, and one on each side) so all leaves are thoroughly covered, similar to the application pattern of systemic sucker control agents. Use a spray pressure of 40 to 60 psi.
